### Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behaviour)
- [ ] Docs / translation only
- [ ] Chore (refactor, dependency update, CI, cleanup)

# Checklist

### Formalities

- [ ] I have read [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and the [Code of Conduct](../CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [ ] I was assigned to the linked issue before starting work.
- [ ] My PR title follows the format: `<type>: <short description>. Closes #<issue>` (e.g. `feat: add blood group compatibility page. Closes #6`).
- [ ] My branch is created from the latest `main` and follows the naming convention (`feat/`, `fix/`, `docs/`).
- [ ] I have reviewed, understood, and tested any AI-generated code in this PR, and I can explain every line.

### Code quality and tests

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes with 0 errors.
- [ ] `npm run build` passes with 0 errors.
- [ ] I added comments where the logic isn't obvious.
- [ ] If tests exist for the area I changed, I added or updated them, and all tests pass.
- [ ] If my change affects behaviour described in README or docs/, I updated those docs too.

### Privacy and safety (required)

- [ ] I did not add any real personal data (names, phone numbers, emails, addresses). All sample data is clearly marked as demo.
- [ ] My change does not expose donor contact details publicly.
- [ ] My change does not scrape or import data from social media, WhatsApp, or third-party donor lists.
- [ ] My change does not add any flow that asks users for money.

### UI changes

<!-- Skip this section if you made no visual changes. -->

- [ ] I attached before/after screenshots (desktop AND mobile, ~390px width).
- [ ] I checked keyboard navigation, form labels, and colour contrast.
- [ ] All new UI text is in `locales/en.json`, not hardcoded.

### Translations

<!-- Skip this section if you did not add or edit a translation. -->

- [ ] I am fluent in the language I translated into.
- [ ] Every key from `locales/en.json` exists in my locale file.
- [ ] I did not use raw machine translation without reviewing it.

# Review process

- Open a **draft PR** early, even if the work is incomplete. Maintainers can then see your progress and help you sooner.
- When it's ready, click **"Ready for review"**.
- After you address requested changes, click **"Re-request review"** next to the reviewer's name. Don't just push silently.
- Please don't tag maintainers repeatedly. Reviews happen within 2–3 days.
